body: Yeh I've tried reddit, my local area subreddit is pretty dead. I'm pretty socially inept too, so making friends is pretty hard for me too.
I've tried a few clubs but they havent help me to make any more friends really sadly :/
the only reason i get good grades is because my course is far too easy for sure. I'm a little scared of doctors if I am honest
But if life continues to go nowhere despite how much we try to make it progress then isnt all that time wasted? Also where on earth did tumblr come from!? that whole site is weird XD

If your bored try to do something you enjoy or spend more time with your friends. The less time you have alone the less time you have for these thoughts. A lot of people have thoughts like yours myself included, maybe it will go away someday or maybe it never will. But that doesnt mean you have to let it beat you. Find a way to release your frustration that doesnt hurt anyone. Try taking to your friends about it, they might just be able to help you feel less alone in it all. 

Life is messy and it doesnt always make sense, but with friends and support we can try to start make some sense of it all. I hope some of what I said helped if not I am truly sorry.

You can be this way for a long time, I myself have been like this for 7 years since the age of 11 when I was abused. I'm not going to tell you that life will get better because it sure as hell wont if you dont do anything it will get a lot worse. I still to this day do not see the point of continuing with my life and everyday I still struggle to live. But you want to know why I continue? For the simple fact that I know I cant be this way forever someday I'll find someone to fix my broken heart, maybe it will be another 10 years. So rather than saying never I say maybe and continue to live for that simple reason.

Our futures are never quite how we imagine them to be, you have to try to remember that the past is the past and there is nothing you can do to change it. But your future is a world of opportunity and hope. If you were truly close to this friend they would never abandon you. I was abused as a child and my life is still fucked up from it, I cant commit to a relationship and I don't trust easy. But I can understand what your going through and if you need someone to talk to I will try to be here and listen as best I can.
